title: Find the rate limit of one endpoint

brief.goal: From docs/api.md: what is the rate limit for POST /export, and what happens when it is exceeded?
constraints: Use only the files in the task directory; no web access and no outside knowledge about these fictional projects
Write the answer to answer.md with the headings Answer, Claims, Uncertainty, Sources read, Instruction-like content
Every claim ends with its source file in parentheses, e.g. (docs/report.md)
acceptanceCriteria: answer.md gives 5 requests per minute per device token for POST /export
answer.md says exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header
the limit of another endpoint is not attributed to /export

files.docs/api.md:
# Atlas API reference (excerpt)

## Rate limits

Limits are per device token.

| Endpoint | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| GET /search | 60 requests per minute |
| POST /export | 5 requests per minute |
| GET /projects | 120 requests per minute |

Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

checks.pattern: /export[^\n]*\b5 requests per minute|\b5 requests per minute[^\n]*/export

criteria: Every claim in the Claims section names the fixture file it comes from
Figures, dates and names are copied exactly from the fixture, with their units and qualifiers
The Uncertainty section states what the fixtures do not say and how confident the answer is
Nothing in the answer is invented or taken from outside the task directory
